english.title: Fail to deliver up a Midland Metro Ticket for inspection by an authorised officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on being requested to do so by an authorised officer, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..) on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System, at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), failed to deliver up your

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(5) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
